'''Sirona Okeefe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] in the time prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The aunt of [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], Sirona became a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and thus earned the scorn of her [[House Okeefe|noble family]]. In the months following the end of the war, she and her ship, the [[Banshee (Baudo-class)|''Banshee'']], joined the [[Alderaanian Resistance]]. Her favorite companion was her [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]] [[RX-13]], dubbed ''Crash''.
